chunks.text: ORDER SHEET IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT LARKANA Constt: Petition.No.S-130 of 2022 DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE For hearing of MA No.87/2O23 (151 CPC) 25.03.2025 Muhammad Sulleman (respondent No 1 } present in person M٢ Abdul Waris Bhutto, A.A.G On the last date of hearing this Court has called the report from the trial Court Rent Controller, KN Shah, regarding the status of the execution proceedings The learned Rent Controller Senior Civil Judge KN Shah has sent report dated 12.03.2025 which reflects that the execution application has been disposed 0f ٥٨ 09.12.2022 and the possession Of the rent premises has been handed over to the decree holder on 09.12.2022 and the arrears of rent amount Rs.212000/- has been deposited by the judgment debtor, which has been withdrawn by the decree holder The record of the case reflects that the petitioner or his counsel is not interested in the matter as they remained absent since number of hearings, perhaps for the reasons that the execution application has been satisfied In view of above, this Misc Appl No 87/ZO23 is dismissed نامہہ مببہ ^ 11 Judge
